BlockStatus.description: Whether the card is open or blocked for various reasons

last4.description: Last four digits of the card number

pinOffset.description: Encrypted pin offset for the card

applicationTransactionCounter.description: Application transaction counter (ATC) for the card

sequenceNumber.description: Used to differentiate issuing the same card and expiration date on multiple plastics

capture.description: Whether the card should be captured at next use

lastModified.description: Time data was last modified (Deprecated. Use updatedOn)

createdOn.description: Time encrypted data was first stored

ExpirationDate.description: Expiration date for the card and will be assumed to be the last millisecond of the month

DataEncryptionKeyId.description: Reference to encryption keys Payment Card Service will use to encrypt the Card object.

publicKeys.description:
List of public keys in PEM format.

Associated private keys can be used to decrypt card data encrypted by Payment Card Service.

items.description:
An object that includes an encrypted data encryption key and a hashed version of the public key used to encrypt it.
The publicKeyHash string is derived using @checkdigit/hash and the caller's public key included in DataEncryptionKeyRequest.

encryptedDataEncryptionKey.description: RSA encrypted data encryption key used to AES sensitive data in the Card object.

transmissionKey.description:
A public key in PEM format.
When creating a card with a specific card number (i.e. /card/{cardId}/number), use the transmissionKey to
encrypt the data encryption key used to encrypt the card number.

History.description: The History object represents the updates to a Card object over time.

dataEncryptionKeyId.description: Reference to encryption keys Payment Card Service used to encrypt the Card object.

storageKeyId.description: DEK's non-derived identifier to be used by Check Digit services only.

encryptedDataEncryptionKey.description: RSA encrypted data encryption key used to decrypt AES encrypted values in Card objects.

LockStatus.description:
A cardholder initiated status. A locked card will fail authorization. Locked cards can be unlocked.

A cardholder may choose to lock a card while temporarily misplaced.

transmissionKey.description: A PEM formatted public key to be used to RSA encrypt a data encryption key.

PinOffsetKeyId.description: Identifier for the PinOffsetKey used to encrypt the data encryption key.

encryptedDataEncryptionKey.description: A RSA encrypted (using transmissionKey) data encryption key that encrypted the encryptedUserDefinedPin.

encryptedUserDefinedPin.description:
User Defined PIN encrypted with an AES generated data encryption key. This is the PIN to be used for new
offset calculation. (plaintext pin has minLength = 4, maxLength = 12)

serviceCode.description: Used to set general guidelines for how the card can be used, e.g. domestic only or international, online authorizations only, etc.

sequenceNumber.description: Used to differentiate issuing the same card and expiration date on multiple plastics.

cardNumberLength.description: Desired number of digits in the card number.

encryptedDataEncryptionKey.description: RSA encrypted data encryption key used to AES encrypt encryptedCardNumber

PublicKeyResponse.description:
This object contains the rsa generated public key for the Payment Card Service. This public key must be used
when transmitting encrypted data to Payment Card Service APIs.

StateStatus.description: The current state of the card
